CORRECTED under FastMNN (the earlier CCA-based claim that no discrete subsets were separable was partly a clustering artefact). The compartment is naive-DOMINANT but not naive-only. Clustering-independent, at the cell level: 87.9% carry a naive-type BCR (IgD+ or IgM+), only 17.0% are class-switched (IGHG1+ or IGHA1+) and 6.7% are CD27+. MKI67 is below 1% in all 9 clusters, so there is no proliferating compartment. However FastMNN DOES resolve a genuine class-switched memory population that CCA fragmented: cluster 3, 1,994 cells (11.6% of the compartment), 54.8% class-switched and 28.0% CD27+ - enriched 4.6-fold for switching and 7.1-fold for CD27 over the rest, with TNFRSF13B 63.4% and ITGAX 29.1%. A small atypical cluster (75 cells) is also resolved. Per-cluster ranges are wider than under CCA: IGHD 26.1-67.0%, IGHM 41.3-94.9%, TCL1A 21.6-77.6%; CD27 below 7% in 6 of 9 clusters and IGHG1 below 6% in 7 of 9.
